facts.fact: 当天结束时 Elliot 仍未被起诉，警方已申请延长拘留。
facts.anchor: Elliot had not been charged by the end of the day. The police had applied for an extension.

facts.fact: Meera 收到 Millie 的回复：她现阶段不接受采访，太难过了，邮件还带了一个哭脸表情。
facts.anchor: Meera had received a reply from Millie, conveying that she would not be speaking at this stage, she was too upset.

facts.fact: 几名记者从 Elliot 公寓离开后把精酿啤酒馆当成临时办公室，占了几张桌子，到处拉电脑线。
facts.anchor: A few of them had set up shop in the craft ale house, taking over several tables and running their computer leads everywhere.

facts.fact: 与 Smith 简短不快地交锋后，她把他打发回酒店，给稿子加一条新的标题行。
facts.anchor: Following a terse exchange with Smith she had sent him back to the hotel to add a thin new top line to the story

facts.fact: 她认为自己用黏人把他推开了，决定让他按自己的节奏慢慢回到她身边。
facts.anchor: She had pushed him away with her neediness. She would let him feel his way back to her in his own time.

facts.fact: Smith 说她不显老也许是“没孩子”的缘故，Kate 猝不及防地一颤。
Smith 说起诉 Elliot 至少能让 Olivia 家人得到正义，Kate 接了一句“但 Emily 的没有”。
她正要讲 Emily 案的细节，Smith 把手覆在她握刀的手上打断，说这话题不适合晚餐。
